facts.summary: The model is the Atlas-7 Dual Boiler, 2026 revision C.
Made by Meridian Coffee Systems of Tacoma, WA.
The brew boiler runs at 9.2 bar during extraction.

facts.expected: every 60 days when water hardness exceeds
